clauses.heading: SAMPLE SERVICE AGREEMENT
clauses.text: This Service Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of January 1, 2024, between ABC Corporation, a Delaware corporation ("Client"), and XYZ Services Inc., a California corporation ("Vendor").
clauses.risk_justification: The clause is a basic agreement definition without any explicit risks or obligations.

clauses.heading: 1. SERVICES
clauses.text: Vendor shall provide software development services as requested by Client. Services include development, testing, and deployment of software solutions.
clauses.risk_justification: Vendor's failure to provide software development services may impact the project's success.
obligations: provide software development services as requested by Client

clauses.heading: 2. PAYMENT TERMS
clauses.text: Client shall pay Vendor $50,000 per month for the services. Payment is due within 30 days of invoice. Late payments shall accrue interest at 1.5% per month.
clauses.risk_justification: Late payments shall accrue interest at 1.5% per month.
obligations: Client shall pay Vendor $50,000 per month for the services

clauses.heading: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY
clauses.text: Both parties agree to maintain the confidentiality of any proprietary information shared during the term of this Agreement. This obligation shall survive termination for a period of 2 years.
clauses.risk_justification: The parties are obligated to maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, which if breached, could pose a risk.
obligations: maintain the confidentiality of any proprietary information shared during the term of this Agreement

clauses.heading: 4. TERM AND TERMINATION
clauses.text: This Agreement shall commence on the date hereof and continue for one (1) year. Either party may terminate this Agreement with 30 days written notice.
clauses.risk_justification: The agreement can be terminated by either party with 30 days written notice, which may pose a risk to the stability of the contract.
rights: terminate this Agreement with 30 days written notice

clauses.heading: 5. LIABILITY LIMITATION
clauses.text: Neither party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising out of this Agreement. Each party's total liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the preceding 12 months.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause limits the total liability of each party to the fees paid in the preceding 12 months.

clauses.heading: 6. GOVERNING LAW
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California, without regard to conflict of law principles.
clauses.risk_justification: The agreement is governed by California law, which may pose regulatory risks.

clauses.heading: 7. ENTIRE AGREEMENT
clauses.text:
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, and agreements.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

CLIENT:
ABC Corporation
By: _________________________
Name: John Smith
Title: CEO
Date: _______________________

VENDOR:
XYZ Services Inc.
By: _________________________
Name: Jane Doe
Title: President
Date: _______________________
clauses.risk_justification: The agreement supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, and agreements, which may reduce potential risks related to misunderstandings or miscommunications.
